name: OpenFoundry preview
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then export __VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS="$CODESPACE_NAME-5173.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN:-app.github.dev}"; fi; nohup pnpm dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort </dev/null >/tmp/openfoundry-preview.log 2>&1 &'
